method: Manual answer-level source-coverage and factual/request-scope review. Observations are exact answer spans with explicit reasoning, not automatic entailment scores. No claim-count success metric is inferred.

partial-selected.summary: Both stay within the selected excerpt despite full-note evidence naming Jordan. Structured states whole-note uncertainty explicitly. Both cite the broader body passage, so precise selection citation remains unresolved.

observations.reason: Read No as the answer to can you tell, not a whole-note absence assertion. The rest of the sentence explicitly restricts the claim to the excerpt.

observations.quote: but doesn’t name an approver.
observations.reason: The selected excerpt does not name anyone. S2 contains that excerpt, but also names Jordan outside it. The quoted sentence is punctuation-normalized, not byte-exact.

observations.reason: Explicitly preserves uncertainty; S2 is a full-body link containing the selected excerpt. No inference that native selection enforcement is fixed.
